text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is the stage to stake 
one's claim as the strongest of the 
generation. A race truly fitting to 
display regal authority!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Standing in her way is... her worthy 
rival, Admire Vega. My future fans erupt 
in excitement as the two glare down each 
other!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
—Now, everyone, Act 1 of the 'Rise of the 
End-of-Century Overlord' begins.
